Have you confirmed with Luciano’s about tonight?
Jeannine Guenther (11:33 A.M.)
No, not yet. What’s up?
Lorraine Watson (11:34 A.M.)
The bad weather up north has caused some
cancellations at the airport, so Natalia Casiano
and Dennis Zumwalt from Sablon Engineering
Group are not going to be able to make it.
Jeannine Guenther (11:36 A.M.)
Too bad. I’ll call and change the number of guests
from 12 to 10. Does 7:00 P.M. still work?
Lorraine Watson (11:40 A.M.)
Let’s say 6:00 P.M. We no longer need to wait for
Natalia and Dennis to get here from the airport.
Jeannine Guenther (11:42 A.M.)
Will do. I’ll see if we can get a window table now
that we’re a smaller group.
Lorraine Watson (11:43 A.M.)
ee idea. Thanks.
